title.en: Shi Kefa remembered after the fall of Yangzhou
title.zh: 扬州城破之后的史可法纪念像

alt.en: A bearded official wears a black court hat and red robe with a crane rank badge; an inscription names Shi Zhongzheng and the painter Li Shizhuo.
alt.zh: 一位蓄须官员戴黑色官帽，穿饰仙鹤补子的红袍；题字标明史忠正公与画家李世倬。

caption.en: Portrait of Shi Kefa by Li Shizhuo, catalogued as a Qing-dynasty work. The painter signs it as a respectful copy. Its date is not specified by the museum; 1645 dates the Yangzhou defense and Shi’s death, not this painting. The scroll also carries later inscriptions, including one dated 1779.
caption.zh: 李世倬所绘史可法像，馆方归于清代，作者署“敬摹”。馆方未给出画幅的确切创作年；1645年是扬州守城与史氏去世的年份，并非此画年代。同卷还有后世题跋，包括1779年的一则。

interpretation.en: Li Shizhuo commemorates Shi Kefa, the defender of Yangzhou in 1645, in an official’s robe and crane rank badge. His signature calls the painting a respectful copy. The same scroll preserves a family letter about the siege; this selected panel is the later portrait.
interpretation.zh: 李世倬以官袍与仙鹤补子描绘1645年扬州守将史可法，署款称“敬摹”。同卷保存一封谈及围城的家书；所选画幅是后世肖像部分。
